module "P_Params.dsp"

product 0 PassPipeline "P_Params"
  pipeline order=0 injection=BeforePostProcess views=Game|Editor requires=- enabled=-
  parameter "Width" float default=2
  parameter "Tint" float4 default=(1, 0.5, 0.25, 1)
  parameter "Taps" int default=4
  buffer "Out" RGBA16F resolution=Render scale=1 (inferred) clear=(0, 0, 0, 0) mips=1
  pass "Blur" compute injection=BeforePostProcess
    shader "Blur.usf" virtual="" entry=MainCS
    threads=(8, 8, 1) (from the shader) dispatch=Out * 1
    write Result = Out
    param A = Width * 2 + 1
    param B = Width * 0.25 + -0.25
    param C = Width * -1 + 0
    param D = Width * -1 + 1
    param E = Weight * 0.5 + 0
    param F = float 6
    param G = float3 (1, 0.5, 0.25)
    param H = int 7
    param I = bool true
    param J = Tint * 1 + 0
    param K = Taps * 1 + 1
    param L = Width * 2 + 0
